priorPhraseEdits.before: Free, 50-person maximum. Storytime tickets are required. Another event, Music and Movement B, will start at 11:15 for those who couldn't get into this session.
priorPhraseEdits.after: This session is free and limited to 50 people. Storytime tickets are required. If you can't get a spot, Music and Movement B starts at 11:15.

priorPhraseEdits.before: Bel Canto Flutes is an all-flute ensemble featuring flutes of all shapes and sizes. Bel Canto Flutes enjoys showing off the beauty and flexibility of the flute with repertoire that spans the ages and genres. Our program for you will feature melodies both familiar and new with anecdotes about the music, its composers, and its origins. Come join us as we share our joy of music making with you.
priorPhraseEdits.after: Bel Canto Flutes plays familiar and new melodies from different eras and genres on flutes of many shapes and sizes. The musicians share stories about the music, its composers, and its origins.

priorPhraseEdits.before: Children can buddy up with a furry friend and read one on one from a favorite book. For kindergarten through 5th grade. Each 20-minute session is with a specially trained therapy dog and volunteer. Reading session time may be shortened if needed to accommodate demand.
priorPhraseEdits.after: Children in kindergarten through 5th grade can read aloud from a favorite book to a specially trained therapy dog and a volunteer. Sessions last 20 minutes and may be shortened if demand is high.
